parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID of the resource plan instance. You can call [QueryResourcePackageInstances]() to query instance ID.

parameters.name: Modules
parameters.description:
The code of the resource plan. Valid values:

- Vulnerability resource plan: **sas_vul_dp_cn**
- CSPM resource plan: **sas_cspm_dp_cn**
- Anti-virus Edition resource plan: **sas_viruspackage_dp_cn**

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the resource plan. The default value is valid. This parameter does not support modification.
